doc:
Defines one or more SMARTS-based rules for generating conformational coordinates. Rules are separated by newline characters (i.e., each rule is defined in a single line). In each line, each space-separated string (i.e., a word) is interpreted as follows: each word is considered a single SMARTS until a word is found that corresponds to any keyword (see below). Once the first keyword is found no more words will be interpreted as SMARTS. There can be one, multi-atom SMARTS (e.g., [#1]-[#6]-[#8]-[*], [#6]-[#8]), or multiple single-atom SMARTS. The order of multiple SMARTS is retained and used to generate the ordered tuple of atom indexes. Recognized keywords are (case-insensitive):
 --> 'Fold=<value>': to specify the extent to which this conformational coordinate should be explored (e.g., 2-fold, 3-fold, etc)
 --> 'GetCurrentValue': requests the determination of the value of the internal coordinate defined by the tuple: distance, angle, or dihedral angle.
 --> 'Values=[<number>,...]': to specify one or more absolute values (degrees for torsions) to assign to the conformational coordinate, independently from the current value. Mutually exclusive with 'Steps'. When used by the GenerateConformers task on a four-atom torsional coordinate, each listed value is the target dihedral for the atoms that define that coordinate. If the Z-matrix encodes the same torsion with different terminal atoms, the assigned internal-coordinate value is corrected so that the requested four-atom dihedral is achieved; for Z-matrix torsions defined in the opposite bond sense the assigned value is negated. By contrast, 'Fold'/'Steps' apply relative increments.
 --> 'OnlyBonded': limits tuples of atoms to those that are connected to form a path visiting the tuple in the order given by the order of the SMARTS. For example, a SMARTS-based rule for tuple '[#1] [#6] [#7]' may be limited to match only substructures where the H atom is connected with any bond to the C atom, which is connected with any bond to the N atom.
 --> 'Steps=[<int>,...]': to specify which steps to take along this kind of conformational coordinate. The magnitude of the step is defined by the fold. For example, a torsion-kind of coordinate with fold=4 has the step length is 90 DEG, so Steps=[2,3] specifies to twist the corresponding bond by 180 and 270 DEG. By defaule no step is specifies, meaning that all steps will be considered.
 --> 'getAtomLabels': request the generation of formatted atom labels to be used when reporting the atom tuple defined by the specific rule that contains this keyword. This keyword activates all the keywords associated with the 'GenerateAtomLabels' task.
 --> 'Prefix=<text with spaces>': to specify a text to be placed before the list of atom indexes.
 --> 'Suffix=<text with spaces>': to specify text to be placed after the list of atom indexes).
 --> 'GeometryConditions=type id0 id1 ... operator [, type id0 id1 ... operator, [...]]' to specify a list of geometry conditions that the tuples must satisfy. Multiple geometry conditions can be specified in a comma-separated list. Each geometry conditions is defined by the syntax 'type id0 id1 ... operator [values]': a space-separated list of strings consisting of the type (i.e., DISTANCE, ANGLE, DIHEDRAL), the list of indexes of the atoms involved in the condition (0-based index of the atom identified by the tuple, not index the overall atom list), the operator (either as string, i.e., CLOSE_TO, LESS_THAN, MORE_THAN, MAX, MIN, or ad symbol <, >, =), and any numerical value that might be needed by the operator (e.g., LESS_THAN/'<' and MORE_THAN/'>' require one reference value, CLOSE_TO/'=' may be used with one value or with two values, where the second is the tolerance value for considering two numbers sufficiently close to satisfy the condition).

Defines one or more (0-based) index-based rules for generating conformational coordinates. Rules are separated by newline characters (i.e., each rule is defined in a single line). In each line, each space-separated string (i.e., a word) is interpreted as follows: each word is considered a single index until a word is found that corresponds to any keyword (see below). Once the first keyword is found no more words will be interpreted as an index. The order of the indexes is retained. Recognized keywords are (case-insensitive):
 --> 'Fold=<value>': to specify the extent to which this conformational coordinate should be explored (e.g., 2-fold, 3-fold, etc)
 --> 'GetCurrentValue': requests the determination of the value of the internal coordinate defined by the tuple: distance, angle, or dihedral angle.
 --> 'Values=[<number>,...]': to specify one or more values (degrees for torsions) to assign to the conformational coordinate independently from the current value when the torsion is defined by 4 atoms, or to be added on the current value for torsions defined only by the 2 central atoms. Mutually exclusive with 'Steps'. When used by the GenerateConformers task on a four-atom torsional coordinate, each listed value is the target dihedral for the atoms that define that coordinate. If the Z-matrix encodes the same torsion with different terminal atoms, the assigned internal-coordinate value is corrected so that the requested four-atom dihedral is achieved; for Z-matrix torsions defined in the opposite bond sense the assigned value is negated. By contrast, 'Fold'/'Steps' apply relative increments.
 --> 'Steps=[<int>,...]': to specify which steps to take along this kind of conformational coordinate. The magnitude of the step is defined by the fold. For example, a torsion-kind of coordinate with fold=4 has the step length is 90 DEG, so Steps=[2,3] specifies to twist the corresponding bond by 180 and 270 DEG. By defaule no step is specifies, meaning that all steps will be considered.
 --> 'OnlyBonded': limits tuples of atoms to those that are connected to form a path visiting the tuple in the order given by the order of the indexes. For example, creates a conformational coordinate on angle '0 1 2' only if atom 0 is connected with any bond to atom 1, which is connected with any bond to atom 2.
 --> 'getAtomLabels': request the generation of formatted atom labels to be used when reporting the atom tuple defined by the specific rule that contains this keyword. This keyword activates all the keywords associated with the 'GenerateAtomLabels' task.
 --> 'Prefix=<text with spaces>': to specify a text to be placed before the list of atom indexes.
 --> 'Suffix=<text with spaces>': to specify text to be placed after the list of atom indexes).
